request: Pull City of Boston 311 service requests from data.boston.gov's CKAN datastore (resource 1a0b420d-99f1-4887-9851-990b2a5a6e17, calendar-year 2026). Cap at 20,000 rows via CKAN datastore_search offset pagination (limit=5000). Enrich with status_band (open/closed/other) and dept_group (PWD / Streets / ISD / Parks / Police / Neighborhood Svcs / Other) using map_values. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 23 - Boston 311 Service Requests' on Tableau Server for city operations analysts. Note: pivoted from Chicago 311 (data.cityofchicago.org) after repeated DNS resolution failures against the Socrata FedRAMP cluster from within TabPy — Boston hosts on Cloudflare and is stable.

sources.name: Boston 311 Service Requests
sources.description: City of Boston 311 service requests, calendar-year 2026 resource (CKAN datastore resource_id 1a0b420d-99f1-4887-9851-990b2a5a6e17). Total ~65k rows for the year. One row per case. Fields include case_enquiry_id, open_dt, sla_target_dt, closed_dt, on_time (Y/N), case_status (Open/Closed), closure_reason, case_title, subject, reason (top-level category — Housing, Public Works, etc.), type (specific request type), queue, department (ISD / PWDx / BTDT / PARKS / BPS / BPD / etc.), submitted_photo, closed_photo, location, fire/pwd/city_council/police districts, neighborhood, neighborhood_services_district, ward, precinct, location_street_name, location_zipcode, latitude, longitude, geom_4326, source. Pulled via CKAN datastore_search offset pagination (limit=5000, cap 4 pages / 20k rows). CKAN wraps the row list in result.records — extracted by json_records_path.

args.name: Boston 311 Trend
args.features_description: Row-level Boston 311 service requests (calendar-year 2026, capped at 20k rows). Fields include case_enquiry_id, open_dt (case open timestamp), sla_target_dt, closed_dt, on_time (Y/N vs SLA), case_status, status_band (open/closed/other), closure_reason, case_title, subject, reason (top-level category: Housing, Public Works, Sanitation, etc.), type (specific request type), queue, department (raw code), dept_group (Public_Works / Transportation / Inspectional_Services / Parks / Police / Public_Schools / Neighborhood_Services / other), districts (fire/pwd/city_council/police), neighborhood, ward, precinct, address, zip, latitude, longitude. Plus calendar features parsed from open_dt.
args.stats_description: Long-form Boston 311 statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over reason, dept_group, status_band, neighborhood). Includes 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Use to spot neighborhood-level spikes in specific complaint categories or shifts in department workload.

outputs.name: Boston 311 Stats
outputs.description: Long-form Boston 311 request statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over reason, dept_group, status_band, neighborhood). Includes 30-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to spot neighborhood-level spikes in specific complaint categories or shifts in department workload.
